name: GAUGE
summary: 以真实测量轨迹和物理属性为依据，评测物理引擎与视频世界模型物理保真度的基准。
summaryEn: A measurement-grounded benchmark evaluating physical fidelity in numerical physics engines and generative video world models.
scaleZh: 约 1,560 次动作捕捉实验
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT；数据许可见发布页
access: Benchmark dataset available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 基准数据集已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 用带不确定度的真实测量检验仿真和生成模型物理保真度
verdictEn: Tests simulation and generative-model fidelity against real measurements with uncertainty
wmNote: 同一测量基准覆盖数值引擎和视频模型，便于识别物理偏差。
wmNoteEn: A shared measurement reference across engines and video models helps identify physical bias.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2608.05948] GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models
evidence.statement: Measured physical trajectories and task-specific observables evaluate simulation engines and video world models against controlled real experiments.
